text:
Animation and Graphics Club 
 Animation and  Graphics club was established in 2023 with the motto of developing 
animation and graphical skills among the students.  The most important part of animation is 
jotting down one’s ideas and drawing them out. The club has a vision of showing how the world 
of animation can be fun to manipulate.  
 The club planned to create and use games to build camaraderie and teach about animation 
by creating frame by frame animations.  The club members work as a collective group and create 
an animation and compute the frames together. The club is planning to introduce an animation 
class room where the thoughts of the members move around, such as interior design classrooms.  
It is sort of gateway between classes and experience. The club was constituted with president, 
vice- president, secretary and treasurer as admin body. 
Dr. K. Sujan Kumar (Faculty coordinator)
